challenges.name: feedback-phrase-report
challenges.title: Extend the report: the most frequent two-word phrases
challenges.description: Most Vietnamese words have two syllables - giao hàng, thân thiện, đóng gói - so the single-word report mixes up hàng in giao hàng with hàng in mặt hàng. Customer care wants the most frequent phrases instead: pairs of neighbouring words. Write phrases, which splits one feedback message into lower-case words (runs of letters and digits) and returns every pair of neighbouring words, without crossing a clause break (. , ; : ! ?), and top, which returns the N most frequent phrases, highest count first and ties in ascending string order. The test runner reads N on the first line and one message per line after it, and prints the top phrases and a totals line.

tests.name: The example: one phrase in every message
tests.input:
2
Giao hàng nhanh. Giao hàng tốt!
giao hàng trễ
tests.expected:
giao hàng 3
hàng nhanh 1
phrases 6, unique 4

tests.name: Commas and full stops end a phrase; ties in string order
tests.input:
3
Giao hàng trễ 2 ngày, shipper không gọi!
Shipper không gọi trước. Giao hàng trễ.
giao hàng trễ, hàng bị móp
tests.expected:
giao hàng 3
hàng trễ 3
không gọi 2
phrases 15, unique 9

tests.name: Upper case, colons, semicolons, a dash and quotes
tests.input:
4

ĐÓNG GÓI ẨU; hộp bị rách
Đóng gói cẩn thận - shipper thân thiện
"Đóng gói" ẩu?
tests.expected:
đóng gói 4
gói ẩu 3
bị móp 1
bị rách 1
phrases 16, unique 11

tests.name: A week of real feedback
tests.input:
5

Hàng bị móp, đóng gói ẩu. Giao hàng chậm.

Gọi tổng đài 3 lần không ai nghe; giao hàng chậm 2 ngày.

ai nghe 2
